data.name: Photography
data.note: Headshots, brand, and environmental photos shot for your site by the person who designed it. A half-day starts at $900 and a full day runs about $1,200, often folded into a build or booked on its own across the Cincinnati region.

data.name: Brand & strategy
data.note: Standalone strategy or brand-identity work for when you need it on its own. Strategy is already built into every website project.

data.name: Care plan
data.note: Optional. Updates, backups, security, and, on the higher tiers, a monthly bucket of small content edits. It does not cover major revisions or new features, which are quoted separately. Skip it and the site is still yours to leave alone for years, with no lock-in.
